management_remarks: Finishing FY25, Reliance Industries crossed Rs 9.58 Lakh Crore in consolidated revenue and Rs 1.71 Lakh Crore in EBITDA as telecom capex intensity moderated sharply post-5G completion. Jio's 5G subscriber base surpassed 170 million with industry-best churn metrics and surging fixed wireless AirFiber installations. In New Energy, solar PV module and battery storage gigafactory construction in Jamnagar progressed on schedule toward commercial commissioning.
analyst_qa: Responding to questions on consolidated ROE and capital intensity, the transition period before New Energy gigafactories reach full utilization creates near-term return headwinds. Global crude differentials and Singapore GRMs remain volatile and challenging amid geopolitical shipping disruptions. Enterprise cloud monetization timelines remain uncertain and subject to calibrated enterprise IT adoption cycles.
